about: Aldactone (spironolactone) 100 mg, by brand name only, is supplied four times from January to October 2026 to a 72-year-old man with the direction to take one tablet in the morning, which is 100 mg a day.

Spiractin (spironolactone) 25 mg is supplied four times from December 2025 to May 2026 to a 68-year-old woman with the direction to take two tablets in the morning, which is 50 mg a day, in the middle of a 14-month history.
Aldactone (spironolactone) 25 mg is supplied with the direction to take one tablet in the morning, which is exactly 25 mg a day and not above it, so the criterion is not met.
